newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Vickers upgrades Venture.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vickers upgrades Venture.

text.p: Vickers Ballas Investment Research said on Wednesday it has upgraded Venture Manufacturing from "neutral" to "outperform" after better-than-expected interim results.
On September 13, the computer hardware contract manufacturer reported an 89.5 percent rise in half-year profits to Singapore $15.16 million.

"The better-than-expected half-year showing has prompted a 25 percent upward revision in full-year earnings," Vickers said in a research report. "The share is fairly valued at the Singapore $3.00 level, representing upside of 30 percent."
Vickers said the company was positioned for further market share gains within the already rapidly growing electronics contract manufacturing industry.

It said Venture's management expected worldwide demand for contract manufacturing services to grow 20 percent a year through the rest of the decade and had set an internal annual sales growth target of 30 percent.
